question: 美国公开组合中，毛利或价值与动量各半的近期分散帮助，是否超出单纯将动量规模减半；同时放弃多少上行。
primary_use: 公开组合的风险分散线索与后续研究优先级，不是股票排序或可交易账户

mechanisms.GP: 毛利相对资产描述经营能力，可能与追逐既往涨幅出现不同的涨跌；公司和行业权重差异是竞争解释。
mechanisms.BM: 价格相对账面权益的便宜程度，可能与动量不同步；困境风险、原库有形权益及交易所筛选差异是竞争解释。

scope: US published aggregate long-short reference returns; not same stock universe or ETF

periods.role: 主要近期描述，固定十年，与已有公开比较共用日期
较早历史背景，不与近期重叠，不叫训练集

history_status: 所有原表已公开，部分均值及其他同族组合已看过；冻结后首次核本问题不使历史变为独立测试；无拟合、无优化、无训练/测试划分

uncertainty.conditioning: outcome-defined subsets are descriptive, not ex-ante signals; resample full paired calendar then condition within each draw
uncertainty.multiplicity: exploratory pointwise ranges; two candidates and multiple outcomes, no selection-adjusted adoption claim

unit: source percent divided by100 once; published sign kept
not_evaluated: fees, short borrow, funding or tax
US ETF or LEI decision improvement

research_budget.prior_family_budgets: unchanged; external new-use diagnostic, do not redo author VME or cash profitability core

acceptance: source/months/units checked before compute; all methods same complete months or abort, no zero imputation; synthetic tests then independent direct source calculations; conclusions per use with counterexample and limitations; no minimum return or IC pass line
gemini_reuse: 2026-10-18 saved Argon high review: distinguish additional information from fewer actions/lower exposure; reject average exposure scaling drawdown and arbitrary thresholds; no new consultation claimed
stop: No parameter or weighting search on negative result; unavailable qualified aggregate source stops this comparison without replacing definitions. Stock replication remains missing separately.
primary_decision_rule: 只有对完整动量及缩半动量的风险比较、上涨代价、候选单用一起解释；不按单个显著数字宣布有效。未预设最小有用幅度，不排除未检出的用途。
top_momentum_definition: Each period largest ceil(0.1*N) Mom returns, tie break date ascending; disclose positivity and zero counts, descriptive only.
source_metadata_notes: GP: value weighted high-low quintile, annual June, nonfinancial; BM: equal weighted high-low decile, annual June, exchanges 1/2, tangible book equity versus fiscal-year-end market equity; Mom12m: equal weighted high-low decile with 3-month portfolio period. Exact metadata in source; not same stock universe or weight.
Beta/BetaFP catalog Sign=1 and RealizedVol denotes CAPM residual volatility; none substituted for low-beta/total volatility.
